notes.title: Linux version! + A small update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140636/e7a85f4d9b07c9137dd1cde058254ff042a66659.jpg[/img]
Hello, friends!
The main news is that [b]the game is now available for Linux!!![/b] 
Linux users, welcome to the world of adventure!

According to the Windows version of the game, a small update!
[b]Fixed:[/b]
1. Increased the display time of each frame of the epilogue.
2. Fixed hanging of the text field in some cases.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140636/4c098679ea88dae2f0fee0c2a7daca3586b9bc2f.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello, dear players![/b]
The most active of you have already written to us a lot of minor flaws and problems. And this update fixes them!

[b]List of fixes:[/b]
1. Fixed the achievement "Smart Guy" for winning all mini-games. Now it should be issued. You may have to go through them again, but that's not for sure.
2. Fixed the display of the number of deaths from 222 to 217 everywhere.
3. Fixed the achievement "Curious" for visiting 30 subcenes. You may also have to run through them again... Or maybe the game will give you right away. Tell me later!
4. Fixed a problem with skipping the Totem mini-game and displaying its pass on other mini-games.
5. Fixed some errors and typos in the text

Thank you for writing about everything you found in the vastness of Dorgan!)
[b]Who wrote the review is generally beyond praise!)))[/b]

notes.title: 70% of the illustrations are ready!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140636/345fa71e1a5b41c4ec889949d5b9a6e20411a680.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, friends!
In the Swordbreaker universe, there are many interesting, strange and fun events that our game will tell you about. Certainly, what will not fall to the lot of a novice adventurer... Perhaps you would like the hero not to become one at all and radically change his fate? Oh, I wish I could hurry up already...

And we want to share with you an important news about the development - we recently overcame an important figure in drawing illustrations - [b]70% of the art is ready![/b]
It is still difficult to name the exact release date, because drawing is a creative process and sometimes it can take longer than we plan. But we are trying!)
Who hasn't tried our little demo yet - welcome to the game page, the demo version is right in the center.

If you have any questions, suggestions or suggestions-do not hesitate to write!
